comment: Dr. McCauley is an incredibly funny and open professor, there is never a dull moment in class. She is sometimes a little bit of a slow roller where it can take time for her to do things you ask of her but she is always responsive to help. She makes learning Russian seem easy for how difficult the language is.

I love her to death. She made everything seem so easy in terms of learning Russian, which is no easy feat. Great explanations, interesting projects. She gave simple/short homework, quizzes and exams were always basic, often we were overprepared. A shame that I graduated and couldn't have her for more.

Dr. McCauley is one of the best professors I've had at UR. She's a walking encyclopedia of Russian language and culture. But more importantly, she makes learning an intimidating language easy and fun - think sing-alongs, hilarious dialogs, Russian prison slang, and lots of dictator jokes. Get ready to learn a lot and lyao while you're at it!

Dr. McCauley is a great Russian professor. She will make you work hard through ample homework and tests, but your Russian knowledge will certainly improve drastically. She is personable and happy to help you outside of class and builds strong relationships with her classes.

Dr. McCauley is amazing, plain and simple. She constantly pushes her students to improve, allowing them to revise their mistakes on papers and express their ideas more succinctly. teaches in the most entertaining format. Great Russian teacher. She really cares about your success and does everything she can to help you achieve it. Lots of worksheets, but she makes them herself and they're helpful. Friendly and approachable.

Yea obvi best professor in language department, no question. what a champ. Claims she has a drill instructor mentality, but really feels like more fun than anything else. she provides a very structured and intuitive way to learning language. Grades based on effort so as long as you apply yourself and give your best effort you will get an A. Big rec

One of the absolute best UR has to offer - FIERCE, passionate, engaging, and incredibly kind. Goes out of her way to make you a more effective communicator, including extensive notes on work + extremely helpful office hours. Most importantly, she makes it obvious that she cares about you and wants to make you an all around better individual.
